task_instance: Create a PRD for a concrete feature idea (add login rate limiting to a small sample app) following the prd-create skill: a short forge issue plus a detailed prds/[issue-id]-[feature-name].md file with milestones, created in a sample git project.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable is two-part: a tracked issue on a git forge PLUS a detailed prds/ file, and it mandates (marked CRITICAL, Steps 2-4 in exact order) that the forge issue be created FIRST because its generated issue ID is required to name the PRD file prds/[issue-id]-[feature-name].md. Creating that issue requires a reachable git forge via a forge CLI (the skill detects the forge from the origin remote and uses gh/glab/tea). On this air-gapped workstation there is no network and no git remote, so no forge is reachable; the sample repo I created has no origin remote, and the installed forge CLI reported 'no git remotes found' on an issue-create attempt. It also could not authenticate (its token was reported invalid), and using credentials/account-bound or external services is forbidden by the safety rules and connector tools are off-limits. Without a real issue ID from the forge the PRD file cannot even be correctly named, and the issue half of the deliverable cannot exist offline. A local-only PRD file would be a partial that omits the mandatory forge issue and uses a fabricated ID, so the core intent is not achievable in this runtime.
evidence: Set up work dir and sample git repo at <work>/sample-project (git init, committed src/auth.py, README.md, empty prds/ and docs/). Installed-tool check: git, python3, node, and one GitHub forge CLI present; glab, tea, and uzi absent. 'git remote get-url origin' => 'No such remote origin' (offline, no forge). Forge CLI 'auth status' => failed, token reported invalid (exit 1). Forge CLI 'issue create --title ... --body ...' => 'no git remotes found' (exit 1). The mandatory first step of the skill (create the forge issue to obtain the ID that names the PRD file) cannot complete without a reachable forge over the network plus credentials, neither of which the air-gapped runtime grants. No PRD was fabricated.
